subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR19: 'If the END-OF-PAGE or the NOT END-OF-PAGE phrase is specified, the LINAGE clause shall be specified in the file description entry associated with the write file.' (--check OK). Sequential arm: CheckWriteEopLinage -> COBOL0860 for both the positive (ws1nolin, `WRITE R EOP ...`) and the negative-only phrase (ws1nolinn, `NOT AT END-OF-PAGE`). Relative/indexed arm: any END-OF-PAGE phrase is rejected outright by KeyedIoBinder.BindWrite under SR3 (COBOL1720), a superset of SR19's refusal there. A LINAGE file with EOP compiles and runs (ws1eop). [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (base WRITE statement; the 2023 text records no change to this rule in Annex E)]
